title: ARCADE: INITIALS AT THE FIRST TOP 10 EXTRACTION
why: His yes to the five recommendations for the Halloween party mode, arcade22. The 3 letter initials card came only at the run end, so a team that walked away mid-run left ??? or nothing on the board. Now the first extraction that puts the run into tonights top 10 opens the initials card on the EXTRACTED banner. It holds the drop while it is up, takes the keyboard (letters, Backspace, Enter) and the pad (up and down change the letter, A next, B back, MENU done), and 20 s with no input keeps what is there. The run row keeps the initials, so the board shows the team name even if they walk off. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade the first extraction that makes tonights top 10 opens the 3 letter initials card and holds the drop until it is done, and the board row keeps those initials.
